title: totalWithdrawal Phase-2 executes the LIVE client balance, not the Phase-1 announced snapshot; story-048 retiming (6h/72h, 78h total) shrinks the community reaction window 4x while three documentation sources still claim 24h/48h
additionalLocations: src/concreteYieldStrategies/ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy.sol:209-240 (_totalWithdraw ignores the amount parameter and re-reads clientBalances live — source-verified)
fingerprintBasis: sha256(src/AYieldStrategy.sol:_executeWithdrawal:announced-vs-executed-live-drift-story048-retiming) — empty entryPoint, legacy hash form; deliberately distinct from H-02 (7b19ceec)
description: The two-phase totalWithdrawal announces an amount at Phase 1 (_initiateWithdrawal snapshots state.balance and emits WithdrawalInitiated) but Phase 2 does not honor it: _executeWithdrawal passes the cached snapshot down, and ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy._totalWithdraw IGNORES the amount parameter, re-reads clientBalances live, and sells proportional shares for the FULL live balance. Deposits arriving between Phase 1 and Phase 2 are swept in excess of the announced figure. story-048 additionally retimed the window (WAITING_PERIOD 24h->6h, EXECUTION_WINDOW 48h->72h, 78h total), shrinking the community reaction window 4x and widening the drift horizon, while AYieldStrategy.sol:414, IYieldStrategy.sol:101, and registry designDecision #5 still document 24h/48h. WithdrawalExecuted additionally emits the cached (announced) amount rather than the actual swept amount (open L-06-run11), so on-chain observers cannot even detect the drift from events.
impact: No external asset theft, loss, or compromise. The executor is onlyOwner and proceeds go to owner() for redistribution; value-conservation holds. The harmed asset is INFORMATIONAL: the anti-rug commitment that the announced amount and documented reaction window represent to the community. A competent, NON-malicious owner running a legitimate migration unknowingly sweeps client deposits made after the announcement, and the protocol's documented transparency commitment materially overstates the community's actual reaction window (6h, not 24h).
attackPath: 1. (Owner-initiated, legitimate-migration context) Owner calls totalWithdrawal Phase 1; _initiateWithdrawal snapshots state.balance = live balance and emits WithdrawalInitiated with that announced amount.
2. During the (now 6h, was 24h) waiting period plus the (now 72h) execution window, authorized clients continue depositing; clientBalances[token][client] grows past the announcement.

3. Owner calls Phase 2; _executeWithdrawal passes the cached snapshot down, but ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy._totalWithdraw IGNORES the amount parameter — it re-reads clientBalances live and sells proportional shares for the FULL live balance (Tier-3 detector: executed 1,209,632e18 vs announced 278,585e18 after a mid-window deposit at the 6h boundary).

4. The full live balance lands at owner(); WithdrawalExecuted emits the stale announced figure. Community watchers sized to the documented 24h window and the announced amount observe neither the true timing nor the true amount.
5. No step is exploitable by an external party; every trigger is onlyOwner and the recipient is the owner.
lawBasis: Law-3 non-obvious owner/operator footgun + commitment-transparency weakening. Surprise test PASSES. Law-1 check (FAITH-15-005): the 6h retiming is story-blessed and NOT an unsafe story, because zero-delay owner exfiltration already exists via emergencyWithdraw (no timelock, works while paused — standing C-01); the waiting period was never the binding rug protection. That domination argument is precisely why this cannot exceed Low.
h02Boundary: NOT a re-escalation of H-02 (7b19ceec, status false-positive — ledger-authoritative; the invariant-results.json 'downgraded-to-centralization' string was wrong per DISC-15-001 and has been corrected). H-02's adjudicated-and-rejected claims were the High theft framing (circular/owner-funded) and the underflow brick (spurious symbolic artifact); both stay suppressed. This entry's root-cause class — announced-vs-executed commitment-transparency gap as an operational hazard PLUS the diff-new story-048 retiming — was never adjudicated, carries a deliberately distinct fingerprint, and is capped at Low.
documentationCheck: NOT-BLESSED. knownIssuesCount=0. designDecision #5 documents the two-phase mechanism at the OLD 24h/48h timings — it blesses the window's existence, not live-over-snapshot execution semantics, and is itself stale (doc leg carried by F-05/FAITH-15-004). No systemAssumption covers inter-phase deposit sweep or the retiming.
tier3Evidence: Detector invariant invariant_P3_PATTERN001_announcedAmountFaithful fails by design under forge and Medusa (executed 1209632.69e18 > announced 278585.41e18 after mid-window deposit at the 6h boundary). Window-boundary tests confirm the 6h/72h/78h constants are implemented correctly.
recommendation: Pin Phase-2 execution to min(announced snapshot, live balance) or require re-initiation when the live balance exceeds the announced figure; fix WithdrawalExecuted to emit the actual swept amount (with L-06-run11); update the 24h/48h documentation at AYieldStrategy.sol:414, IYieldStrategy.sol:101, and registry designDecision #5 (F-05); refresh C-01 report text and off-chain monitoring SLAs to the 6h reaction window.
